flawed_step: Lines 18–19 incorrectly identify the roots in the odd-m case.
counterexample: Take p=7 and m=55. F_55=139583862445≡-1 (mod 49), while F_54=86267571272≡1 (mod 49). Since φ^m=F_mφ+F_{m-1}, φ^55≡1-φ=-φ^{-1} (mod 49). This is neither -φ nor φ^{-1}, contradicting lines 18–19.
assessment_summary: The odd-case quadratic has roots -φ and -φ^{-1}, not -φ and φ^{-1}. The explicit p=7, m=55 instance refutes the root classification on which the subsequent exponent argument relies.
